critique.evidence: Strong cyber-forensic art direction, crisp cards, disciplined cyan/red semantics, and an excellent headline hierarchy. Mobile stacks cleanly. However, desktop feels under-composed with excessive dead space, tablet’s staggered evidence path is visually disjointed, and the footer floats far below the main narrative. The translucent tablet header allows distracting content bleed-through; mobile removes the brand wordmark and red-mode action, while clipped horizontal navigation has weak scroll affordance. Tiny, low-contrast mono labels also reduce legibility and polish.
critique.fix: Tighten desktop/tablet vertical composition, align the evidence cards into a clearer continuous path, and bring the explanatory footer closer to the narrative. Give the header an opaque or blurred backing, retain compact brand/red-mode cues on mobile, add an obvious horizontal-scroll affordance, and increase the size/contrast of micro-labels.
